primary_game_plan: Develop BGU, turn landfall and recurring creatures into cards and mana, then assemble a compact sacrifice or land engine.
secondary_game_plan: Grind with Field of the Dead, Seedborn Muse, and repeatable commander activations.
interaction_priorities: preserve graveyard interaction for opposing recursion
mulligan_requirements: functional mana or one land plus credible one-mana acceleration/selection
do not chase ideal synergy after a functional free redraw
cards_normally_preserved: Bojuka Bog when opposing recursion matters
expected_development_turns: turns 1-2 establish green and land engines
later turns convert recurring creatures and landfall into a win
threat_assessment: Disrupt faster combo engines first; preserve recursive resources unless converting them creates a concrete advantage.
